run_catch_exceptions_test: run the googletest catch exceptions test suite to verify C++ and SEH exception handling
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_fixture_cons: test that C++ exceptions thrown in a test fixture constructor are caught and logged correctly
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_set_up_test_: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUpTestSuite are caught and remaining lifecycle methods still run
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_test_body: test that C++ exceptions thrown in the test body are caught and TearDown still executes
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_unhandled_ab: test that unhandled C++ exceptions abort the program when catch_exceptions is disabled
